items.html: It is thus found that the principal illumination and revelation of the Mochin in a person is through Daat, and it is that which gives him knowledge. And therefore the fetus, in which the brain of Daat has not yet been revealed at all, and also the two Mochin of HB are sealed, as mentioned, therefore the fetus has no Daat at all, and it is like a silent stone, unlike the time of nursing, when it already has some Daat for what it needs, as above.
